DXC issue #1768 -- Arrays of structs in GS OutputStreams
https://github.com/microsoft/DirectXShaderCompiler/issues/1768

WHAT TO LOOK FOR

Both compilers fail *internally*. This is a compiler crash, not a
diagnostic. The exact symptom varies by build, and on trunk it varies
between runs of the same input:

    Program terminated with signal: SIGSEGV
    error: cast<X>() argument of incompatible type!

Same bug, different symptom -- which is what makes this easy to
mis-triage. A local Debug build asserts instead; Compiler Explorer
runs Release builds, where asserts are compiled out. So "no assert
here" does not mean fixed: look for abnormal termination, not for a
particular message.

Arrays of structs in a geometry shader output stream were never
implemented, and the unimplemented path crashes rather than rejecting
the shader with a message.

No release from v1.4.1907 (2019) to v1.9.2607 handles it.
